entry.label: Unified Theory of Systems Intelligence
entry.description: Damian Allen's unpublished proto-theory proposing a synthesis of systems and cognitive-science frameworks, possibly using coupled nonlinear differential equations. It is not presented as established or validated.
entry.canonical_definition: Damian Allen's unpublished proto-theory proposing a synthesis of systems and cognitive-science frameworks, possibly using coupled nonlinear differential equations. It is not presented as established or validated.

profile.title: Unified Theory of Systems Intelligence
profile.canonical_definition: Damian Allen's unpublished proto-theory proposing a synthesis of systems and cognitive-science frameworks, with a possible coupled nonlinear differential-equation formulation.
profile.summary: UTSI is maintained as an inspectable research lead, not an established theory. No public paper, derivation, parameterization, validation or critique was supplied.
profile.why_it_matters: The idea exposes how Damian Allen currently tries to connect his lineages. Its value here is the explicit synthesis claim and testable gaps, not premature authority.
key_distinctions: named synthesis target versus demonstrated integration
11-framework claim versus more than 11 visible strands
espoused_lineages: Damian Allen interview, diagram and correspondence
common_misreadings: UTSI is not a recognized field theory.
The graph does not validate a coupled-equation model.
The diagram's frameworks are not necessarily commensurable.
open_checks: Obtain a public working paper or model specification.
Invite adversarial review from each source tradition.
profile.editorial_note: Private material is paraphrased and locator-limited. Inference, recollection, public corroboration and unpublished theory remain distinguishable.
